scripts.diagrams: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11 -i docs/ARCHITECTURE.mmd -o docs/ARCHITECTURE.png -w 2400 -s 2 -b white && npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11 -i docs/WORKFLOW.mmd -o docs/WORKFLOW.png -w 2400 -s 2 -b white

comments.overrides: Patched transitive dependencies pulled in by the Hardhat 2 toolchain. npm's own fix for each of these is a major upgrade to Hardhat 3, which is a config-format rewrite we are not taking mid-build. Each pin below stays inside the dependant's expected major, so the toolchain API is unchanged. Revisit when migrating to Hardhat 3.
